instruction: A cinematic fashion portrait photograph in a medium shot at eye-level, set in a minimalist indoor studio with a plain beige wall. On the left, the red-haired woman in the oversized beige striped blazer (R1) stands in profile facing right, turning her head to look directly at the camera with a neutral expression. Directly behind her, the blonde woman in the white t-shirt and black pants (R2) stands close, facing left in profile and looking slightly upward. The blonde woman (R2) places her left hand flat on the red-haired woman's (R1) shoulder. Harsh, direct sunlight streams from the upper left, casting sharp diagonal shadows across the subjects and the background wall, creating a warm, muted color palette.
